baseline_finding: Four directly relevant primary full texts have now been reviewed; they establish prior art for policy-decision explanation, abductive analysis allowing changes to both rules and facts, provenance attack-path attribution, and adaptive rule-based PIDS. Full collision analysis across all required neighboring areas remains incomplete.
required_action: Continue full-text review across formal XAI, abductive/contrastive explanations, MUS/MCS, provenance, policy debugging, temporal/versioned policies, and distributed monitoring; map actual TracePolicy definitions and claims against each source and assess significance.

baseline_finding: Elsevier's current Computers & Security journal page states a moratorium on submissions featuring AI/ML as significant components; the manuscript frames its subject as explainable intrusion detection and must be assessed against this policy.
required_action: Determine with editorial guidance whether explicit non-ML policy reasoning/XAI falls within the moratorium; do not infer acceptance from the 2026 rejection's scope comment.

baseline_finding: The four-way ablation now enumerates all cross-products of separate minimal-core families and tests unions against the full joint intervention table. All 168 unions from 120 selected Docker alerts and all 11 unions from nine controlled fixtures were jointly sufficient; every case had a union equal to a joint minimal core. A constructed, independently table-checked TracePolicy-semantic witness has two sufficient matched unions and two insufficient crossed unions, falsifying universal composability. No necessary-and-sufficient characterization or independent realistic evaluation exists.
required_action: Derive and verify a composability characterization under the paper's exact semantics; add prespecified realistic scenarios and an untouched evaluation; integrate both the finite-sample null and adversarial counterexample without overstating practical value.

baseline_finding: The current audit package does not provide an independent proof audit covering all manuscript definitions and theorems T1-T5, vacuity, intervention existence, and a necessary/sufficient composability characterization.
required_action: Perform theorem-by-theorem verification and adversarial counterexample search before relying on theorem claims.

baseline_finding: BETH is one-host exploratory, THEIA is a familiar engagement/derivative, and LID-DS CVE-2020-23839 has already been used; no untouched independent confirmatory holdout is established.
